assumptions: Tm is primer3's calc_tm with the buffer 10x lists (10 mM monovalent, 20 mM divalent, 10 mM dNTP, 5 µM oligo, Schildkraut salt correction).
The accessions given as the gene, its isoforms included, are not off-targets.
limits: Without BLAST results no target is checked for off-target homology, and the result says so.
Homopolymers and low complexity are not screened: the note names them without a threshold.
Which passing targets to keep is ours (preferred junctions, then the coding sequence, then 5' to 3'); 10x's own designer is not public.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which 40 nt targets of this transcript meet 10x's Xenium custom-panel rules, and which would another transcript also bind?

description: Design Xenium custom-panel padlock targets on the subject transcript to 10x Genomics' published rules (CG000683): two 20 nt arms whose primer3 melting temperatures fall in their windows, a ligation-junction dinucleotide the Xenium ligase accepts, no run of five G in the probe, at least four mismatches across both arms to every other transcript in a BLAST search, and probes at least 10 bp apart. Without BLAST results it returns the targets to search and says the off-target check has not been run.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

arm_length.description: length of each arm; the target is twice this. 10x's arms are 20 nt, shorter only for a short target whose Tm stays in range. In nt. Advanced.

blast_csv.description: blastn -outfmt 10 output for the targets FASTA this tool returns, searched against the transcriptome (not the genome) with -word_size 7 -strand plus. Without it no target is checked for off-target homology.

gene_accessions.description: comma-separated accessions (no version) that are this gene, its isoforms included: hits to them are not off-targets. Empty: the subject's name. Only applies when blast_csv is set.

junctions.description: ligation-junction dinucleotides to accept, from 10x's empirical ligase preferences; 10x strongly recommends avoiding the nonpreferred four.

max_arm_tm.description: highest Tm of each arm (inclusive). In °C.

max_full_tm.description: highest Tm of the whole target (inclusive). In °C.

max_g_run.description: longest run of G the probe may carry; 10x: avoid five or more. Advanced.

min_arm_tm.description: lowest Tm of each arm (inclusive). In °C.

min_full_tm.description: lowest Tm of the whole target (inclusive). In °C.

min_mismatches.description: fewest mismatches across both arms an off-target hit must carry for the target to be kept; gaps and unaligned ends count. Only applies when blast_csv is set.

prefer_cds.description: rank targets inside the subject's CDS feature before the untranslated regions, as 10x advises where possible.

probes_per_gene.description: targets to keep; 10x's predesigned panels use eight per gene.

spacing.description: fewest bases between two kept targets. In bp.

tm_rule.description: which melting temperatures must fall in their windows. 10x: the full length between 68 and 82 °C or each arm between 50 and 70 °C.

name: design_xenium_probes

explanation.description: the derivation chain: conclusion, interpretation and machinery, generated from this run

probeCount.description: how many targets were kept. Null until `blast_csv` is given

probes.description: the kept targets, each with its 0-based start, target (mRNA sense), probe (its reverse complement), arm and full-length Tm, junction and its class, and the fewest off-target mismatches. Null until `blast_csv` is given

stages.description: what each rule took in and kept, in order, with the reason a skipped check did not run

targetsFasta.description: the targets that pass the Tm, junction and G-run rules as FASTA, named xenium_<1-based start>, for blastn
